mapper.select: SELECT id, template_code, sms_config_id, provider_template_code, require_fields, priority, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, version, remark FROM sys_sms_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} AND status = 1 AND priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM sys_sms_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} AND status = 1) LIMIT 1
